brief.summary_1line: Rama explains Vasistha’s miraculous birth from the seed of Mitra and Varuna and introduces the continuation of Nimi’s story.

image_candidates.scene_text: From a sacred vessel containing the seed of Mitra and Varuna, the sage Agastya emerges as a radiant ascetic before departing.
The newborn sage Vasistha rises from the vessel of divine seed as gods look on, his body glowing with spiritual light.
